contexts.text: He spoke from brotherly love so great that his brother could not refrain from shedding tears. SE 3146:end.
Internal sadness... produces the shedding of tears (by correspondence).
They can move others to shed tears... SE 4553.
A tenderness of gladness from them which drew tears from my eyes.
In the Original it is said the tear of the wine.... Tears are what fall in drops.
Grief on account of truth destroyed, is signified by, Mine eyes are consumed with tears ().
A hard-hearted Spirit was so affected by the speech of an Angel that he shed tears. He said it was love speaking, and that he had never shed tears before.
The shedding of tears is predicated of truth, or falsity.

God shall wipe away every tear from their eyes () = that they shall be no longer in combats against evils and their falsities, and thus not in griefs; but in goods and truths, and consequently in heavenly joys from the Lord. ( = a state of blessedness from the affection of truth, after falsities have been removed by means of temptations. AE 484.)
God shall wipe away every tear from their eyes () = that the Lord will take away from them all grief of mind; for the shedding of tears is from grief of mind.
The jealousy of a wife... is like grief weeping...
Inmost mercy is attended with tears.
A Spirit who inflowed into the eyelashes of the left eye, which seemed as it were to emit tear drops... he was in external mercy...
(These infernals) tried to inspire... the shedding of tears...

That a tear from the eyes = grief of mind on account of falsities, and from falsities, is because by the eye is signified the understanding of truth; and hence a tear = grief because there is no understanding of truth, consequently, because of falsities. Illustrated.

The shedding of tears, and weeping aloud both = grief on account of falsities and from falsities; but the shedding of tears, grief of the mind; and weeping, grief of the heart. Explained, Illustrated. AE 695:16.
